decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location and Site Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Existing and Proposed Site Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Proposed Site Plan DSHIP14 (Received 10.12.2025)Existing Loft Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Existing Roof Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Existing and Proposed West & North Elevations (Received 10.12.2025)Existing and Proposed East and South Elevations (Received 10.12.2025)Existing and Proposed Long & Cross Sections (Received 10.12.2025)Proposed First Floor Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Proposed Loft Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Proposed Roof Plan (Received 10.12.2025)Proposed Front Elevation Casement Windows (Received 10.12.2025)Front Garden Details (Received 10.12.2025)Hardstand Cross Section (Received 10.12.2025)Copy of Window Quotation Letter (Received 10.12.2025)Heritage Statement Executive SummaryHeritage Statement Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in the materials shown on the approved plans and supporting information. Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

Prior to the construction of the rear dormer, a detailed schedule of materials to be used for the dormer shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The schedule shall include, where appropriate, manufacturer specifications and photographs. The development shall thereafter be implemented in full accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

The parking space shown on the approved plans shall not be brought into use until a vehicular crossover has been formally approved by the Highway Authority and constructed in full accordance with that approval.Reason: To safeguard pedestrian safety and maintain safe access to the site.

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the brickwork for the new front boundary wall shall match the brickwork of the front elevation of the main building in terms of brick type, size, colour, texture, bond, and mortar mix the new front garden wall shall not exceed 0.6 metres in height.Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area and to safeguard pedestrian safety and maintain safe access to the site.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Rear dormer, replacement of existing hardstand with tiled path, new hardstand for single car space with associated crossover and front wall.
